name: Aleph
summary: The first sulphur-containing phenethylamine to have been evaluated for CNS activity for stimulant or psychedelic purposes.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Aleph is known to be a superagonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (EC50 = 10–66 nM; Emax = 114–191%). It has weak MAO-A inhibitory activity with an IC50 of 5.2 μM. For comparison, amphetamine has an IC50 of 11 μM and 4-methylthioamphetamine (4-MTA) has a value of 0.2 μM.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

summaryZh: 阿列夫-1是一種有機化合物，化學式為C12H19NO2S。它是一種苯丙胺類化合物，為致幻劑。它最初由亞歷山大·舒爾金合成，並以希伯來字母的第一個字母命名。它的鹽酸鹽是已知的。

uses.en: It has no medical use. It is a rare research chemical, known mainly from Shulgin's writings and from laboratory studies of serotonin receptors.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，是一種罕見的研究化學品，主要見於 Shulgin 的著作與血清素受體的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，是一种罕见的研究化学品，主要见于 Shulgin 的著作与血清素受体的实验室研究。

sideEffects.en: Very little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of its family, the DOx amphetamines, tend to be long lasting and can cause anxiety, confusion, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, and difficult experiences.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響幾乎沒有資料。同家族的 DOx 類安非他命迷幻藥作用時間通常很長，可能引起焦慮、混亂、心跳與血壓上升，以及難受的經驗。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响几乎没有数据。同家族的 DOx 类安非他命迷幻药作用时间通常很长，可能引起焦虑、混乱、心跳与血压上升，以及难受的经验。

fact.en: Aleph was the first sulphur-containing phenethylamine tested for effects on the mind. Its name, the first letter of the Hebrew alphabet, marks it as the start of Alexander Shulgin's Aleph series.
fact.zh: 阿列夫-1 是第一個被測試精神作用的含硫苯乙胺。它的名稱是希伯來字母的第一個字母，象徵它是 Alexander Shulgin 的 Aleph 系列的起點。
fact.zhHans: 阿列夫-1 是第一个被测试精神作用的含硫苯乙胺。它的名称是希伯来字母的第一个字母，象征它是 Alexander Shulgin 的 Aleph 系列的起点。
